outcome: response time for green code cesarean section
cohort: The study analyzed medical records of 123 pregnant women who underwent green code cesarean sections at Prof. Dr. I.G.N.G. Ngoerah Hospital Denpasar between January 2020 and December 2022.
finding: The average response time for green code cesarean sections (21.03 +/- 10.17 min) did not meet the hospital's standard of <=8 minutes, with only 6.5% of cases complying.
mod_finding: The study found that the emergency response times for green code cesarean sections significantly exceeded the hospital's target, highlighting deficiencies in the rapid management of this mode of birth.
